en: Multiview color postcard showing landmarks of Brașov, Romania: at left the Saint Nicholas Church; top-right the Council House on Piața Sfatului; bottom-right the Black Church with the wooded mountain backdrop. The city coat of arms appears on the front. The back has Romanian postal layout, a Poșta Română 40 bani stamp, a circular postmark reading PREDEAL with a 1974 date, and a bilingual caption listing the three sights.
